verdict_summary: High-retention, low-drama engineering investment. Six years of escalating scope and adaptation at Bridgepoint proves high loyalty and low flight risk. While she requires 4-6 weeks of multi-agent ramp-up, her production discipline prevents costly outages.

strengths.claim: Proven 6-year retention and continuous internal adaptation from backend to AI
Track record of picking up new domains (OCR then RAG) quickly with low overhead
Strong reliability bet who instituted lasting team quality processes

gaps.claim: Requires upfront payroll investment and mentoring to ramp on multi-agent frameworks
